body:
I'm tagging this as a discussion since it is unclear if this is a bug or not. ButtonGroup is a resource which buttons are connected to, and it exists outside of the tree, so to me it doesn't seem like ButtonGroup's behaviour would be based around the buttons being in the tree or not (compared to if ButtonGroup was a parent node that other Button nodes were added to as children). The solution you mention of setting `button_group` to `null` is the one that makes the most sense to me intuitively if you no longer want the button to act as part of the button group, though I can definitely see how it can be confusing as well given the behaviour of other parts of the engine.

Do you have some more concrete examples of cases where having the non-visible button have its toggle handler run is an issue? That might help give an understanding of why this behaviour can be an issue and how it should potentially be documented or changed.
